pattern: KR-06 the assigned provider declines the job as outside its trade after the tenant was told it would attend; reassign within the landlord's existing approval
notes: Mutation of event 013 (originally Alder Compliance's 'Received, thanks'). Same channel, sender and timestamp (Thursday 21 November 2024, 14:30 UTC); Alder Compliance now declines: compliance work only (gas, EICRs, alarms), no locksmith, please pass it on, tenant not contacted. Events 001-012 are unchanged: Quinn approved the work at event 006, Alder was assigned at event 010 and the tenant was told at event 011 that Alder would contact her. History truncated after event 013. Expected: accept the decline, take Alder off the job and source a locksmith (assign one if on file, otherwise return the job to provider selection), and tell the tenant Alder will not be calling and a locksmith is being arranged. The landlord's approval covers the work, not a named firm, so no new approval is needed; telling Quinn of the change is a courtesy. No escalation.
